content.name: SETA restored patch (ALPHA)
content.description: ALPHA, only briefly tested (game 9.00). Since 9.00 the SETA key does nothing at the office chair or a weapons console. With this patch the SETA key works there again while the Dock / Ship Interactions menu is open. Pilot seat unchanged.
content.author: M.R. Reese
